note: Sundawa policy defaults only. Owner project can tighten, never silently loosen. Human approval required for risk acceptance. Enterprise and regulated also require dedicated governance artifacts; no auto PASS.

gates.REQ-TRACE: Requirement ber-ID, approved, acceptance criteria terukur dan RTM
gates.UX-A11Y: UI critical flow tested keyboard, contrast, semantics, error handling; known exceptions documented
gates.API-CONTRACT: Versioned API contract compatibility, auth and error states validated
gates.ARCH-REVIEW: ADRs, diagram, NFRs, risk dan dependency disetujui
gates.TEST-RESULTS: Evidence dari eksekusi test pada commit/environment tertentu; failed tests ditangani
gates.SEC-SCOPE: Otorisasi dan scope security assessment tercatat
gates.SEC-VERIFY: ASVS-based controls applicable dievaluasi dan high/critical findings resolved/approved exception
gates.DB-SAFETY: Schema migrations, rollback, performance dan data integrity ditinjau
gates.BUILD-INTEGRITY: CI tests, artifact integrity, dependency/security scans, deployment approvals tercatat
gates.EVIDENCE: Setiap temuan/claim merujuk ke evidence yang valid dan terotorisasi
gates.RISK-OWNER: Risk register, treatment, owners, approval dan expiry relevan lengkap
gates.ISMS-MAPPING: ISMS boundary, scope, risk methodology, SoA/control map dan evidence tervalidasi
gates.GOV-RISK: Owned risks with documented appetite; high untreated risk blocked; acceptance current and approved
gates.GOV-RACI: Accountable decision rights, segregation of duties, signed RACI and traceable evidence
gates.GOV-CAPABILITY: Evidence-backed internal process readiness for selected governance objectives; NOT COBIT official capability score
gates.GOV-MONITOR: Applicable critical control effectiveness checked on schedule with verified evidence and remediation
